newsitem.title: UK: British Airways secures $2.5 billion debt facility.
newsitem.headline: British Airways secures $2.5 billion debt facility.

text.p: British Airways Plc has secured a $2.5 billion financing facility to support its acquisition of new wide-bodied aircraft, it said in a statement on Tuesday.
The facility will finance the purchase of 19 Boeing 747-400 and 13 Boeing 777-200 aircraft due for delivery between now and the end of 1998.
It will enable individual aircraft to be financed in a number of different ways with a maximum term of 15 years.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi and NatWest Markets will be bookrunners during the syndication process, BA said.
There are five arrangers -- Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Fuji Bank, Industrial Bank of Japan, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp and NatWest Markets.
